scope: Shared Verse of the Day display/share formatter for all 13 languages, including Android/iOS notification content. Canonical scripture assets retain their punctuation.
validation_method: Python reference-model invariants and source-contract tests; Kotlin regression fixtures are added for Continuous Integration. No local app build or Kotlin test execution was performed.
invariants: Observed typographic quotation marks normalize to ASCII.
Explicit double and single speech events close in proper order.
Outer double quotation encloses the excerpt.
Words and inline display tags are preserved.
Apostrophes in contractions and possessives remain apostrophes.
